question.text:
If ( G ) is a group and ( H ) is a subset of ( G ) such that ( H ) is closed under the group operation and every element in ( H ) has an inverse in ( H ), which statement about ( H ) is true?

  1. ( H ) is necessarily a subgroup of ( G ).
  2. ( H ) must contain the identity element of ( G ).
  3. ( H ) is a cyclic group.
  4. ( H ) is necessarily the entire group ( G ).
question.subject: Set Theory & Algebra
